title: If your comments get deleted
summary: A channel announcement clarifying that he never deletes comments or bans commenters; YouTube is pre-deleting comments from accounts it flags as inflammatory or that use filtered words. He says the censorship hurts engagement and discussion and suggests contacting him on Instagram if comments don't appear.

claims.claim: He never deletes comments or bans anyone, no matter what they say.
YouTube pre-deletes comments from profiles known for inflammatory comments and filters comments containing certain words, which he cannot see or answer.
YouTube's comment censorship hurts him more than commenters by stifling engagement and discussion, while bot comments are left untouched.
He will talk to people even if they're rude; YouTube removes such comments because it cares about its image.
He answers and likes every single comment he can see.
